Banks Channel at Dawn.description: A quiet dawn study of Banks Channel, with open sound water and the low shore of Wrightsville Beach.
Banks Channel at Dawn.direction: Red Oak frame, oyster paper tone, pale coral dawn and blue-green water.

Masonboro Salt Marsh.description: Tidal creeks fold through the salt marsh at Masonboro Island Reserve in this coastal study.
Masonboro Salt Marsh.direction: Keep the creek network open and use spartina green and dark tidal blue.

Wrightsville Under Sail.description: A small sloop crosses the sheltered waters of Wrightsville Beach, with the low barrier island on the horizon.
Wrightsville Under Sail.direction: An off-center cream sail and a narrow wake with room around both.

Carolina Beach Dunes.description: A dune study inspired by the sandy ridges and longleaf pines at Carolina Beach State Park.
Carolina Beach Dunes.direction: Layer pale sand with longleaf green. Show the river-side terrain.

Kure Pier Morning.description: Morning light crosses the Atlantic beneath the fishing pier at Kure Beach.
Kure Pier Morning.direction: Use the low pier deck and repeated pilings. Compare directly with the existing Kure pier print before advancing.

Cape Fear Waterfront.description: The Cape Fear River seen from the Wilmington waterfront, with the Riverwalk tracing the bank.
Cape Fear Waterfront.direction: Use the continuous boardwalk, brick buildings and open river. Keep individual buildings impressionistic.

Bald Head Maritime Forest.description: Live oak branches lean over a sandy trail in the maritime woods of Bald Head Island.
Bald Head Maritime Forest.direction: Use a low, spreading live oak canopy and native palmetto shapes at ground level.

Masonboro Inlet Study.description: An aerial study of the meeting of sound and ocean at Masonboro Inlet.
Masonboro Inlet Study.direction: Keep Wrightsville to the northeast, Masonboro Island to the southwest and the Atlantic to the east.

Banks Channel Woven Throw.description: Bands of blue and oyster follow the quiet lines of Banks Channel.
Banks Channel Woven Throw.direction: Require a genuinely woven construction and woven sample detail. The public snapshot returned knit and printed blanks.

Salt Marsh Cushion.description: A branching tidal creek crosses a field of marsh green in this cushion design.
Salt Marsh Cushion.direction: Use a quiet cream reverse if supported. Confirm seams and crop with a real sample.

Cape Fear Coastal Candle.description: A candle with a river-blue label inspired by the Wilmington waterfront.
Cape Fear Coastal Candle.direction: Keep the glass clear and the label spare. Confirm scent choices and required safety copy.
Cape Fear Coastal Candle.templateName: Soy Wax Candle In A Clear Glass Jar

Masonboro Textile Wall Hanging.description: An open pattern of tidal creeks and marsh grasses for a textile wall hanging.
Masonboro Textile Wall Hanging.direction: Require a purpose-made hanging with a finished edge and attachment. Do not convert a blanket or flag by changing the label.

Sloop Knit Crewneck.description: A small single-mast sloop sits on the chest of a navy knit crewneck.
Sloop Knit Crewneck.direction: Use intarsia or the template's supported knit method. Oyster sail, single teal wake.

Pelican Knit Crewneck.description: A brown pelican in profile sits on the chest of an oyster knit crewneck.
Pelican Knit Crewneck.direction: Use an open silhouette and small warm accent. Verify knit resolution at actual size.

Blue Crab Knit Quarter Zip.description: A small blue crab sits below the shoulder of a knit quarter zip.
Blue Crab Knit Quarter Zip.direction: Use oyster and deep blue with a restrained coral accent. Check separation from the zipper.

Lighthouse Knit Cardigan.description: A spare lighthouse motif sits on the chest of a navy knit cardigan.
Lighthouse Knit Cardigan.direction: Reference the Old Baldy silhouette before drawing. Check motif placement with the button placket closed.

Sloop Embroidered Polo.description: A small sloop is embroidered on the chest of a pique polo.
Sloop Embroidered Polo.direction: Use one cream sail and two short tide lines; no text and no border.
Sloop Embroidered Polo.templateName: SOL'S Unisex Premium Pique Polo Shirt

Pelican Embroidered Polo.description: A small brown pelican in profile is embroidered on a pique polo.
Pelican Embroidered Polo.direction: Use a clean silhouette and restrained thread palette; inspect the beak and eye in the stitch proof.
Pelican Embroidered Polo.templateName: SOL'S Unisex Premium Pique Polo Shirt

Sea Oats Heavyweight Long Sleeve.description: A small group of sea oat stems arcs across the chest of a heavyweight long sleeve.
Sea Oats Heavyweight Long Sleeve.direction: Use a restrained muted gold design and leave the sleeves unmarked.
Sea Oats Heavyweight Long Sleeve.templateName: AS Colour Unisex Premium Heavyweight Long Sleeve Shirt

Cape Fear Packable Jacket.description: A small tidal-line mark sits on the chest of a packable jacket.
Cape Fear Packable Jacket.direction: Confirm actual packability and embroidered area support; inspect packed and worn views.

Banks Channel Beach Towel.description: Narrow tide lines run across a beach towel in channel blue and oyster.
Banks Channel Beach Towel.direction: Confirm towel pile, print side and edge crop in the design editor.

Masonboro Beach Tote.description: A branching marsh creek sits low on a natural cotton beach tote.
Masonboro Beach Tote.direction: Use a small dark-teal mark. Check against the existing Fourthwall sloop tote and Shopify coastal totes.

Salt Marsh Travel Pouch.description: A travel pouch with a small tidal creek motif in marsh green.
Salt Marsh Travel Pouch.direction: Require a purpose-made zip pouch and verify its lining and zipper. Existing Shopify pouches must be reviewed before advancing.

Cape Fear Beach Blanket.description: A beach blanket design with broad blue and oyster bands drawn from the Cape Fear River.
Cape Fear Beach Blanket.direction: Require a beach-appropriate blank. An indoor throw or knit blanket needs a separately approved change in product scope.

Coastal Beach Cart.description: A compact cart for carrying beach gear from the parking lot to the sand.
Coastal Beach Cart.direction: Confirm wide wheels, folded dimensions, freight and open and folded photos. Compare with current Beach Setup gear.

Soundside Picnic Mat.description: A picnic mat for spreading out by the sound.
Soundside Picnic Mat.direction: Prefer oyster and navy. Check packed size and compare with existing beach and picnic blankets.

Harbor Folding Table.description: A low folding table for a picnic setup near the water.
Harbor Folding Table.direction: Verify leg locks, load rating, footprint and corrosion-sensitive hardware.

Dockside Dry Bag.description: A roll-top bag for keeping small essentials together on a day near the water.
Dockside Dry Bag.direction: Verify closure and capacity. Use no waterproof rating or flotation claim without evidence.

Captain Canvas Weekender.description: A canvas weekender for a short stay on the coast.
Captain Canvas Weekender.direction: Require a verified canvas composition, hardware close-ups and review against the Sloop Weekender.

Harbor Travel Organizer.description: An organizer that keeps small travel pieces together.
Harbor Travel Organizer.direction: Check interior pocket layout and photograph both open and closed.

Coastal Toiletry Case.description: A zip case for toiletries on a weekend away.
Coastal Toiletry Case.direction: Require verified lining and a clear difference from current zip pouches.

Floating Phone Pouch.description: A phone pouch for a day near the water.
Floating Phone Pouch.direction: Require evidence for floating load, waterproof rating and phone dimensions before adding those claims.

Harbor Woven Lantern.description: A woven lantern with a warm glow for a sheltered porch.
Harbor Woven Lantern.direction: Require a safe light source with verifiable power specs and appropriate markings. Avoid open-flame claims.

Coastal Ceramic Sculpture.description: A ceramic object for a narrow shelf or side table.
Coastal Ceramic Sculpture.direction: Require original, unbranded form and stable base. Verify breakage packaging.

Soundside Serving Tray.description: A serving tray for bringing a few pieces out to the porch.
Soundside Serving Tray.direction: Verify dimensions, finish and food-contact status. Default to serving packaged goods until evidence exists.

Marsh Woven Basket.description: A woven basket for keeping small pieces together at home.
Marsh Woven Basket.direction: Verify weave, interior dimensions and exact finish. Use no named fiber without supplier evidence.

Soundside Picnic Basket.description: A lidded basket for carrying a picnic down to the sound.
Soundside Picnic Basket.direction: Check handle attachment, usable capacity, included pieces and oversize shipping.

Harbor Bottle Carrier.description: A carrier for a bottle on a day out.
Harbor Bottle Carrier.direction: Verify diameter, height and closure. Omit duration claims unless independently supported.

Coastal Insulated Picnic Carrier.description: An insulated carrier for a picnic near the water.
Coastal Insulated Picnic Carrier.direction: Confirm capacity, cleanability and shipping. Reconcile against existing coolers.

Dockside Reusable Tableware Set.description: A reusable tableware set for eating outside.
Dockside Reusable Tableware Set.direction: Verify the exact pieces, composition and available food-contact evidence. No dishwasher or heat claims without proof.
